summary: Test suite is conceptually comprehensive but critically incomplete and brittle. Covers all major requirements (XML/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, workflow validation), but references missing fixture files (simple.junit.xml, matrix run files, malformed.*, all-passing directory), missing workflow file, missing .actrc, and undocumented module dependency (powershell-yaml). Design suffers from brittle patterns: ActIntegration tests assert exact markdown output like '| Total | 9 |' (fragile to formatting), hard-coded test case names preventing parameterization, missing edge cases (empty testsuites, case-sensitivity in status fields, duration boundary values). Tests cannot run as provided. If missing files existed, rigor would still be 3 due to gaps in edge-case coverage.
